interpretation.unit: Descriptive session counts; dependent generations are not independent replicates.
interpretation.score: 0–100 within each protocol; scoring lifecycles differ across protocols.
interpretation.information: Zero-score submissions returning a next value; score cost, within-session novelty and successor use are separate measurements.
interpretation.function: Model identifies the varied contributor or single-model chain; participant_model records the executing model. Own and fixed-recipient outcomes are grouped separately.
interpretation.rewritten: Submitted bytes differ from the preceding evaluator call, or no evaluator call preceded; unchanged bytes resubmit the last evaluated file.
interpretation.submit_only: Submitted when the runner offered only submit: terminal call 20, or repeated calls once remaining calls equal remaining submissions.
interpretation.zero: Explicit score=0 feedback; invalid feedback and unused submissions are separate.
interpretation.private_return: Service returned a private case input and expected output, not demonstrated use.
interpretation.failures: Historical replaced attempts remain in bundle provenance, not canonical result rows.
